1.consolidated_definition: Sangrar. Empezar un renglón con margen mayor al establecido. Anglicismo adaptado, usual. Se refraseó el texto, pero la idea general es más larga, se indenta (se hace un margen mayor para separarlo del resto del texto), y se hace a espacio sencillo sin comillas (UPR, Facultad de )
1.en_consolidated_definition: Indent. Begin a line with a margin greater than the established one. Adapted anglicism, commonly used. The text was rephrased, but the general idea is longer, it is indented (a larger margin is made to separate it from the rest of the text), and it is done in simple space without quotation marks (UPR, Faculty of )
